mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_rag_sync (document_key, title, source, desired_action, revision, status, attempt_count, next_retry_time, create_id, create_time, update_id, update_time) VALUES (#{documentKey}, #{title}, #{source}, #{desiredAction}, #{revision}, 'PENDING', 0, NOW(), 1, NOW(), 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), source = VALUES(source), desired_action = VALUES(desired_action), revision = VALUES(revision), status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, next_retry_time = NOW(), last_error_code = NULL, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM policy_rag_sync WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_retry_time <= NOW() ORDER BY next_retry_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE policy_rag_sync SET status = 'FAILED', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, next_retry_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(300, POW(2, attempt_count + 1)) SECOND), last_error_code = #{errorCode}, update_time = NOW() WHERE document_key = #{documentKey} AND desired_action = #{desiredAction} AND ((revision = #{revision}) OR (revision IS NULL AND #{revision} IS NULL))
